content_sections.heading: Innovsource Services Technician (CSSD) Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About Innovsource Services
content_sections.text: M/s. Innovsource Services Pvt. Ltd. issued this notice, and its Supervisor signed it. The selected candidates will be deployed at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre in Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam.

content_sections.heading: Innovsource Services Technician (CSSD) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The number of posts is likely to increase or decrease as per the requirement of the centre.

content_sections.heading: Innovsource Services Technician (CSSD) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 30 years. Age relaxation can be given to an exceptional candidate based on the recommendations of the committee. Candidates must meet one of these two essential qualification and experience routes: Candidates must also be willing to work in shift duties, including nights, Sundays and holidays. See the official notification for the full eligibility wording for this post.

rows.qualification: 12th Std. in Science and Diploma of 1 year / 06 months in C.S.S.D. from a recognized institution
B.Sc. Graduate from a recognized institution

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview. Candidates must also be ready to provide any additional employment proof documents if required before or after the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary. The tenure is a fixed period of six months from the date of joining. The tenure can be extended further as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Innovsource Services Technician (CSSD) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect the documents listed below. Go to the HRD Department, first floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam. Attend on 12 November 2026 between 09:30 A.M and 10:30 A.M. Bring these documents to the interview: All original certificates One set of Xerox copies covering education, experience or relieving documents, and the last 3 months' payslips One set of self-attested copies of all certificates Updated resume Recent passport size photograph Photocopy of PAN card and Aadhaar card The originals and Xerox copies are mandatory. Without them, a candidate strictly will not be allowed to attend the interview. For any query, call 0891-2871 (Extn- 538).

faq.question: Q1. What time should I reach the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The notice sets the interview between 09:30 A.M and 10:30 A.M on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Can a B.Sc. graduate apply for the Technician (CSSD) post?
faq.answer: Yes. A B.Sc. graduate from a recognized institution qualifies with 01 year of experience in a C.S.S.D. Department.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience do I need with a C.S.S.D. diploma?
faq.answer: A candidate with 12th Std. in Science and a 1-year or 06-month C.S.S.D. diploma needs 03 years of experience in a C.S.S.D. Department.

faq.question: Q4. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary, with a fixed six-month tenure that can be extended as per requirement.

faq.question: Q5. Will the work involve night shifts?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be willing to work shifts, including nights, Sundays and holidays.

faq.question: Q6. Which payslips should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry Xerox copies of your last 3 months' payslips along with your education and experience or relieving documents.

faq.question: Q7. Can the number of posts change?
faq.answer: Yes. The 02 posts advertised are likely to increase or decrease according to the centre's requirement.
